# OneMind Market

> OneMind Market is a local business directory and discovery platform in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. It connects native entrepreneurs and helps people find trusted local businesses, services, articles, and community content.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://onemindmarket.in/): Search local businesses by location and category
- [About](https://onemindmarket.in/about): About OneMind Market and how the network works
- [Join](https://onemindmarket.in/join): Submit a business to the OneMind Market network
- [Gallery](https://onemindmarket.in/gallery): Photo and video collection
- [Articles](https://onemindmarket.in/articles): Articles and community content

## Site structure

- Location pages: https://onemindmarket.in/{location}
- Category pages: https://onemindmarket.in/{location}/{category}
- Business profiles: https://onemindmarket.in/{location}/{category}/{business}

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://onemindmarket.in/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages
